title: The dashboard positions, risk, trades and health route tests mock the statements and the price helper and feed decimal-ETH rows, so the numbers the operator sees (P&L, exposure, daily loss, live price, stale flag) are never computed from production-shaped rows

evidence.note: buildPositionsWithLivePrices, the whole route body, is mocked; every case asserts the mocked object comes back (for example "returns stale price when queryPrice fails" :114-142 never calls queryPrice)
getPnL, getPnLChartData and the limit statements are mocks
limits case feeds { total: 1.5 } and { total_loss: -0.25 } (decimal ETH)
trade rows carry sell_revenue 0.10 / sell_gas 0.001 as decimal numbers
production sell rows store amountOut as a wei integer string (AUD-DB-002)
open-position count and exposure are mocked constants

sibling_sites_checked: All dashboard route tests in test/integration/api (auth, chains, controls, health, positions, risk, trades, wsPush). chains/controls are AUD-TESTI-008/-007; auth runs the real middleware and login and is sound; wsPush mocks the helper too (broadcast wiring only). The unit sibling for the risk SQL is AUD-TESTU-017.
severity_rationale: S3: display-only routes (the risk gates themselves are covered by AUD-TESTU-017); the mocks mean a wrong P&L or exposure figure on the dashboard is invisible, which misleads the operator but does not move funds by itself.
recommendation: Phase 28: run the routes against a temp DB seeded through the real write paths (decimal buy, wei sell) and assert the displayed P&L, exposure and daily loss; run buildPositionsWithLivePrices with a scripted quote provider.
affected_cases: GET /api/risk/limits: returns position limit, exposure limit, and daily loss utilization
GET /api/risk/pnl: returns cumulative data points from per-event sell data (D-07)
